entities.summary: Ingunn Utsi is a Norwegian Sámi sculptor, painter and book illustrator from Repvågstranda in Norway's Nordkapp Municipality. In recognition of her contributions to Sámi culture, in 2019 she was elected an honorary member of the Sámi Cultural Association. One of her most celebrated works is Gudni II, a sculpture she created in 2016 on the trunk of a pine tree in the Art Park of Ii, Finland.
